# ex: implicit addr applied in non-selector substitution context
ex {
	var p *T
	F(p) -> G(p)
}
-- x.go --
package m

type T struct{ X int }

func F(p *T) int { return p.X }
func G(p *T) int { return p.X + 1 }

func H(t T) int {
	return F(&t)
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -6,5 +6,5 @@
 func G(p *T) int { return p.X + 1 }

 func H(t T) int {
-	return F(&t)
+	return G(&t)
 }
